title: Restarting composting at the Central Maui Landfill
summary: As of March 2026, the department plans to submit a permit for its compost program shortly. It says keeping green waste out of the landfill is a priority, and the green waste it receives is needed to mix with sewage sludge so the sludge can be landfilled. In December 2023, a county recycling official said composting at Central Maui Landfill could restart in about six months, and county officials said it could supply local compost and cut off-island purchases.
